newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end down.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates ended down on Tuesday amid uncertainty about the status of funds available in the market and are likely to rise on Wednesday owing to a central bank open market operation, dealers said.
"Because of surplus liquidity in the system, the overnight market traded in the range of five to seven percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.

In the morning session, major deals were dealt at five percent but offers suddenly jumped to 10 percent, though no trade was reported at this level, he said. Later deals were struck at six and seven percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
